Weekend data for home? 🇲🇼

Send airtime or data to family in Malawi from South Africa in seconds, so they're connected for the weekend.

1️⃣ Buy a 1Voucher, OTT, Blu or FNB Voucher at your local store
2️⃣ Dial *130*31026*VoucherPIN#
3️⃣ Follow the menu and enter their number with 265, without the first 0

Works on Airtel and TNM. No app, no data, any phone.
Questions? WhatsApp +27 60 636 0061 💬

linkedin:
For many families, the weekend is when people call home. For someone in Malawi, that call only happens if there's airtime or data on the phone.

At Fluxr we've made topping up from South Africa as simple as a USSD code. Buy a 1Voucher, OTT, Blu or FNB Voucher at a local store, dial *130*31026*VoucherPIN#, follow the menu, and airtime or data reaches an Airtel or TNM number in Malawi in seconds.

Why build on USSD and cash vouchers? Because the people sending money home often have the least data to spare. A short code that works on any phone, paid with vouchers people already buy, takes the app, the bank card and the data bundle out of the equation.

This Friday we're putting Malawi 🇲🇼 first.

Interested in partnering with us, or in becoming a Fluxr Agent? Message us on WhatsApp at +27 60 636 0061 or visit www.fluxr.co.za.
